$description: Spacing scale, verbatim from the clone's Tailwind spacing extension. Values are literal px (this project overrides Tailwind's rem-based core scale).
notes: space.36 and space.60 are explicitly enumerated in the config with source comments explaining that omitting them makes Tailwind fall back to its rem core scale (144px / 240px) — see tailwind.config.js:62-72.
Section vertical rhythm is space.120 on nearly every section; space.240 is used for the bottom padding of /careers Perks and /blog newsletter.
